summary: Backend-only re-verification of the amoCRM token-masking P0 fix (follow-up to iteration_119's 5/6). Extended the existing regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_amocrm_token_masking_iteration119.py from 6 to 13 tests -> 13/13 PASSED. (1) FIXED CASE CONFIRMED: with Mongo amocrm_token='SECRETTOKEN123456', POST /api/integrations/amocrm/settings with amocrm_token='••••3456' returns 200 and Mongo STILL holds 'SECRETTOKEN123456' (mask no longer destroys the credential). Same for '••••', '•', '****', '*' and '' (parametrized, all preserve; GET afterwards still reports token_set=true, masked='••••3456', domain wm-kalkulator.pl untouched). (2) REAL TOKEN UPDATES: POST amocrm_token='REALNEW777' -> Mongo becomes 'REALNEW777', GET does not leak it (raw '', masked '••••W777'). Earlier case POST 'NEWTOKEN9999' also updates. (3) NO LEAK regression: GET returns amocrm_token='', amocrm_token_masked='••••3456', amocrm_token_set=true and the raw token string is absent from the whole JSON body; /api/integrations/amocrm/debug-info also does not leak it. (4) SAVE WITHOUT TOKEN (GET body minus webhook_urls POSTed back with amocrm_token='') keeps the stored token. CLEANUP DONE: integration_settings.amocrm_token and amocrm_domain unset again; verified via Mongo (fields absent) and via public GET ('', '', false). Domain wm-kalkulator.pl was only used as a temporary seed value and is no longer stored. No frontend testing performed (backend-only request).
critical_code_review_comments: STILL OPEN (from iteration_119, unrelated to this fix): GET and POST /api/integrations/amocrm/settings are completely UNAUTHENTICATED. Any anonymous caller can overwrite domain/token/field mappings or read the masked config. Put both behind admin auth.
GET /settings hand-whitelists response keys; any newly persisted field must be added there or a UI round-trip save will silently wipe it (this class of bug already regressed twice).

Minor: the guard rejects a legitimate token consisting only of '*' characters — acceptable in practice for amoCRM long-lived tokens, but the rule is a heuristic; consider a dedicated boolean flag (e.g. token_changed) from the UI instead of sentinel-string sniffing.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily seeded integration_settings(type=amocrm).amocrm_token ('SECRETTOKEN123456' / 'NEWTOKEN9999' / 'REALNEW777') and amocrm_domain='wm-kalkulator.pl'; both fields removed after the run (self-cleaning module fixture). enabled=true was already true before this run and is left as-is.
test_credentials: admin/admin123 (preview) — not needed, settings endpoints are unauthenticated
context_for_next_testing_agent: amoCRM token masking is now fully green: GET never leaks the raw token, POST preserves the stored token for empty / bullet-containing / all-asterisk values, and a real token still updates. Regression suite is self-seeding and self-cleaning: run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_amocrm_token_masking_iteration119.py -q` (13 tests). DB currently has amocrm_token/amocrm_domain UNSET (neutral). Only remaining gap on these endpoints is the missing admin authentication on GET/POST /api/integrations/amocrm/settings.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_119 failure root cause: save_settings() detected masks with `set(incoming_token) <= {'•','*'}`, which is false for the real mask '••••9999' (trailing real chars), so the mask was persisted as the token. Current code treats a token as 'no change' when it is empty, contains '•', or is all '*' — verified working for all mask shapes emitted by _mask_token().
